lines.translation: He gathers up that which brings corruption;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: se chhod chaliaa khin mahi gavaar ||5||
lines.translation: leaving them, the fool must depart in an instant. ||5||
He wanders in attachment to Maya.
He acts in accordance with the karma of his past actions.
Only the Creator Himself remains detached.
God is not affected by virtue or vice. ||6||
Please save me, O Merciful Lord of the Universe!
I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Compassionate Lord.
Without You, I have no other place of rest.
Please take pity on me, God, and bless me with Your Name. ||7||
You are the Creator, and You are the Doer.
You are High and Exalted, and You are totally Infinite.
Please be merciful, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.
Slave Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God. ||8||2||
Basant Kee Vaar, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੈ ਹੋਹੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam dhiaai kai hohu hariaa bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and blossom forth in green abundance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖੰਤੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਇਹ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam likha(n)tai paaeeai ih rut suhaaee ||
lines.translation: By your high destiny, you have been blessed with this wondrous spring of the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: van trin tribhavan mauliaa a(n)mrit phal paaee ||
lines.translation: See all the three worlds in bloom, and obtain the Fruit of Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਲਥੀ ਸਭ ਛਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil saadhoo sukh oopajai lathee sabh chhaaee ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Holy Saints, peace wells up, and all sins are erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak simarai ek naam phir bahuR na dhaaee ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, remember in meditation the One Name, and you shall never again be consigned to the womb of reincarnation.. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜੇ ਬਧੇ ਮਹਾਬਲੀ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)je badhe mahaabalee kar sachaa dhoaa ||
lines.translation: The five powerful desires are bound down, when you lean on the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਯੁ ਖੜੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapane charan japaaian vich day khaRoaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself leads us to dwell at His Feet. He stands right in our midst.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਤ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: rog sog sabh mit gae nit navaa niroaa ||
lines.translation: All sorrows and sicknesses are eradicated, and you become ever-fresh and rejuvenated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਮੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: din rain naam dhiaaidaa phir paai na moaa ||
lines.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You shall never again die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis te upajiaa naanakaa soee phir hoaa ||2||
lines.translation: And the One, from whom we came, O Nanak, into Him we merge once again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਥਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਕਹ ਰਹੈ ਕਹ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kithahu upajai kah rahai kah maahi samaavai ||
lines.translation: Where do we come from? Where do we live? Where do we go in the end?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਖਸਮ ਕੇ ਕਉਣੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh khasam ke kaun keemat paavai ||
lines.translation: All creatures belong to God, our Lord and Master. Who can place a value on Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੁਣਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahan dhiaain sunan nit se bhagat suhaavai ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate, listen and chant, those devotees are blessed and beautified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਦੂਸਰੁ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar saahibo doosar lavai na laavai ||
lines.translation: The Lord God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable; there is no other equal to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sach poorai gur upadesiaa naanak sunaavai ||3||1||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has taught this Truth. Nanak proclaims it to the world. ||3||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: basa(n)t baanee bhagataa(n) kee || kabeer jee ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Basant, The Word Of The Devotees, Kabeer Jee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The earth is in bloom, and the sky is in bloom.
Each and every heart has blossomed forth, and the soul is illumined. ||1||
My Sovereign Lord King blossoms forth in countless ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah dekhau tah rahiaa samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see Him there pervading. ||1||Pause||
The four Vedas blossom forth in duality.
The Simritees blossom forth, along with the Koran and the Bible. ||2||
Shiva blossoms forth in Yoga and meditation.
Kabeer's Lord and Master pervades in all alike. ||3||1||
The Pandits, the Hindu religious scholars, are intoxicated, reading the Puraanas.
The Yogis are intoxicated in Yoga and meditation.
The Sannyaasees are intoxicated in egotism.
The penitents are intoxicated with the mystery of penance. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਜਾਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mad maate kooo na jaag ||
lines.translation: All are intoxicated with the wine of Maya; no one is awake and aware.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗ ਹੀ ਚੋਰ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਸਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g hee chor ghar musan laag ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The thieves are with them, plundering their homes. ||1||Pause||
Suk Dayv and Akrur are awake and aware.
